{{Top}}
A '''terrarium''' was a container in which one could keep plants and small animals. [[Lob Doluff]] had a terrarium containing a lizard from the [[Zebitrope system/Legends|Zebitrope system]]. On the back of this lizard grew a mold named [[Lesai/Legends|lesai]], which was also a highly addictive drug.
